connectionType: regime-conditioned transfer and observational equivalence of natural transitions and missing-frame seams

verifiedEvidence.integrity: The authenticated 172,605,872-byte L0002 AVI was deterministically decoded to 95,504 32 by 32 gray frames; both implementations use raw SHA-256 6bfe5a05a9825344bfa84f380a42d16b486885030429dba8818093d0b5b69df1.
verifiedEvidence.independence: Python and Node independently derive scales, train five fixed candidate families, select one family per gap on validation, generate all injection positions, and agree on every call with maximum numeric difference 7.11e-15.
verifiedEvidence.sealedPerformance: Singleton recall is 0%; block-2, block-4, and block-8 recall are 3.906%, 4.688%, and 7.031%. Aggregate FDR is 96.875%, and every unmodified control produces a call.
verifiedEvidence.naturalConfounder: Ordinal 77,596 is the top natural transition for singleton, block-4, and block-8 models. Its frame mean falls 5.99 to 0.30 while the unauthenticated count-equal command mapping contains a 10.364-unit position jump at the 99.997th step percentile.
verifiedEvidence.unmeasuredConfounder: The block-2 maximum at ordinal 92,905 has an image jump at the 99.985th percentile but only an ordinary 0.08-unit mapped command step, showing that command-boundary exclusion alone cannot remove all false alarms.

commonStructure: A process twin fails outside its training regime when a target transition can be generated by an unseen state change. A finite measurement fails to identify one history when two causes—an ordinary but extreme regime transition and an omitted frame—produce the same measured seam. RC47 makes those statements the same discrimination problem: before transferring a model or selecting a history, the recorded state must make the competing causes separable under a false-alarm bound. L0002 does not satisfy that condition for the fixed image-only families.

variableMapping.refusal to call L0001: retention of the observational equivalence class

validWhen: The intact source sequence is authenticated and synthetic truths are injected after features and model families are fixed.
A distinct sealed interval estimates natural-transition extremes and is not used to choose thresholds.
The state variables that generate regime boundaries are observed with calibrated timing.
A target call is allowed only in strata where competing natural transitions are represented and the false-alarm bound passes.
breaksWhen: Temporal nonstationarity produces a natural transition larger than every validation transition, as in RC47.
Command ordinals are treated as frame identities despite the absence of a verified join ledger.
A state-conditioned exclusion is designed after seeing which test transitions caused false alarms and then evaluated on the same block.
A bounded synthetic error rate is described as proof of the unique physical history.
minimumValidation: Add a timing or state channel that is independent of image intensity, freeze a causal classification of allowed regime boundaries before outcomes, and rerun deletion injections on an untouched layer or acquisition. Success requires zero unsafe unmodified calls, at least 95% recall for each gap, at most 1% FDR, and explicit refusal for unseen states. A verified exposure ledger bypasses the inference test and directly adjudicates identity.
surfaceAnalogyRisk: Both problems use the word transfer, but the connection is not linguistic. It is the shared likelihood-overlap condition between ordinary target events and source-calibrated alternatives. The mapping does not imply that an additive-manufacturing camera models semiconductor yield or arbitrary chip replication.

affectedProblems.UP-605: Shows in a bounded same-layer example that a model can fail even before cross-tool transfer when the target interval contains a regime transition absent from validation. Transfer certificates therefore require state coverage and an extreme-event refusal rule.
affectedProblems.UP-315: Shows that finite images do not distinguish a missing-frame seam from every natural transition. With count evidence alone, the 23 omissions leave choose(94,736,23), about 2^305.77, order-preserving missing sets.

status: The image-only cadence route is prospectively rejected within L0002. The external-timing and regime-conditioned route is a next-cycle proposal, not a validated solution.
